title: a multi-endpoint dependency names the endpoint that is actually missing
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4 review). A dependency keeps only its FIRST client in `sourceRef`, and the deferred warning decided whether to survive by comparing that one slot with its own name — so for `from a, MissingX` it reported `a`, the endpoint that RESOLVED, and said nothing about `MissingX`. Each deferred endpoint name now re-asks the question about itself.
